text: The pediatrician is very lovely and kind.

I was very impressed. I took my child for vaccinations and the pediatrician provided excellent care and advice. The nurses and staff were kind and lovely. The clinic was clean, spacious, and the service was fast.
I went to get my rabies vaccine and they didn't have the brand they used. The staff helped me find a vet that did and gave me excellent advice. I was very impressed.

My son received his vaccinations here, and the service was excellent. The nurses handled the children very well and provided great service. The pediatrician was beautiful and clean, like she showered ten times a day! She assessed the children's development thoroughly, was gentle, and gave advice without us having to press her for answers. It was very reassuring. The standards haven't dropped at all. I've been to other children's clinics, but now I rate this one as number one. I wanted to share this positive experience and leave a review from my genuine feeling.
The doctor gave good advice and the staff provided good service.
The service was excellent and the staff were very lovely and friendly.
